about_the_game:
Build your path to a high score with your own strategy!

Block Pile is a creative block-building, strategy-driven roguelite where you manage a floating island in the sky. Stack, place, and combine various types of blocks to trigger chain reactions, accumulate points, and complete construction goals in each round.

Features

  • Plan ahead and place each block with purpose—every drop can become the start of a massive score chain. Different blocks come with unique effects, and clever combinations can lead to explosive point gains.

  • Dozens of block types to choose from, offering countless build variations. As you progress, construction goals become more challenging, but rarer and more powerful blocks will also appear.

  • Easy to pick up, hard to master. While the controls are simple, building a stable and efficient structure requires careful planning and thoughtful decisions.

  • Each round ends when your blocks run out. Make the most of limited resources, build higher, score bigger, and survive the ever-shifting construction loop.

  • Collect new block resources to expand your island. Every choice you make shapes your final structure—and determines your maximum score.

short_description: Block Pile is an ever-evolving journey of construction. In this deeply immersive strategy-building game, you will develop floating islands, use the unique effects of various blocks to achieve the highest score possible, and explore countless combinations and building possibilities.
